title: GovernanceResult
description: Types the data payload flowing through Governance Effectors/Receptors when the payload is a governance result message. A governance result conveys the outcome of a governance evaluation — pass, warning, or failure — along with optional finding references. Extending archetypes add domain-specific result shapes via $ref/allOf composition. Source: ITIP Meta-Governance Framework; GSM Directive/Norm/Ascription governance grammar.

resultType.description: Governance result discriminator. EVALUATION_RESULT — outcome of an evaluation cycle (rule execution against a subject). COMPLIANCE_RESULT — aggregated compliance posture for a governed entity under a framework. SOURCING_RESULT — outcome of a framework sourcing operation (success/partial/failure). Source: ITIP meta-governance; GSM Ascription lifecycle.

outcome.description: Tri-state governance outcome. PASS — all evaluated norms/directives satisfied. WARN — non-blocking findings detected (informational or advisory). FAIL — blocking findings detected (compliance breach). Source: ITIP evaluation model; AppraisalFinding severity semantics.

subjectRef.description: URI reference to the governance subject that was evaluated (e.g., 'gsmarc://tenant/definitions/{id}'). Source: GSM Ascription lifecycle; ITIP evaluation model.

frameworkRef.description: URI reference to the governance framework under which this result was produced. Source: ITIP framework catalog.

findingRefs.description: Ordered list of URI references to AppraisalFinding instances produced during this governance evaluation. Empty array when outcome is PASS with no advisory findings. Source: ITIP AppraisalFinding archetype.
